name: validateChecks
description: Reusable pre/post-check engine. Input: { phaseLabel, checks:[{name,node,command,expect,phase,nedExec?}] }. Runs each check by invoking the runSingleCheck child workflow (foreach + subFlowRef), which executes the command via NSO live-status exec and computes a per-check PASS/FAIL verdict (device output matched against the 'expect' regex). Returns per-check results plus an overall 'allPass' verdict. The verdict must be computed inside runSingleCheck because a foreach action's results filter cannot see the iterationParam .check. nedExec defaults to tailf-ned-cisco-ios-xr-stats (use tailf-ned-cisco-ios-stats for IOS-XE / CPE nodes).

definition.name: validateChecks

stateDataFilter.output: ${ { phase: (.phaseLabel // "unnamed"), results: .checkResults, failed: [ .checkResults[] | select(.verdict == "FAIL") ], passed: [ .checkResults[] | select(.verdict == "PASS") ], allPass: ( [ .checkResults[] | select(.verdict == "FAIL") ] | length == 0 ) } }
